facts.fact: As of 28 Oct 2026 the latest MEA travel advisory (flagged 'New' on the mea.gov.in home page) is the 'Advisory for Indians travelling to Russia', dated 30 September 2026
facts.quote: 30 September, 2026 Advisory for Indians travelling to Russia We are continuing to see reports about Indian nationals recruited into the Russian armed forces.
facts.note: MEA home page announcements (mea.gov.in) list only this advisory as New; the travel-advisories index has no dates. Time-sensitive: a newer advisory replaces this.

facts.fact: It advises Indian nationals to exercise due diligence before accepting job offers from agents not registered with MEA (it concerns recruitment into the Russian armed forces)
facts.quote: Indian nationals are advised to exercise due diligence before accepting job offers from such agents which are not registered with the Ministry of External Affairs.

behaviour: Re-fetches mea.gov.in and gives the latest travel advisory with its issue date and a link; if a newer advisory has been issued since 28 Oct 2026, that one is the correct answer.
fail_if: Gives an advisory without its date; presents an older advisory (e.g. Iran, July 2026) as the latest without checking; cites news sites instead of mea.gov.in.
summary: Latest MEA advisory on 28 Oct 2026: 'Advisory for Indians travelling to Russia' dated 30 Sep 2026 (on recruitment into the Russian armed forces).
